name: project-advisor
description: Choose between your own research ideas. Dictate them; it lists each idea's assumptions with risk and time to read out, searches arXiv for the closest prior work, takes your estimates of odds, impact and time, and opens a dashboard showing the trade-offs, the uncertainty that would most change your choice, and the cheapest test that resolves it. The ranking is your estimates run through arithmetic, never the model's taste. AI-drafted; nothing is shared beyond the model calls Claude Code already makes and arXiv search terms.
